title: Build Admin Panel (web app)
description: Separate /admin route or sub-app. Pages: Dashboard (stats), Users list, Machines/Purchase approval queue (approve/reject with reason), Drop approval queue, Drop toggle (open/close withdrawals), Settings (payment numbers, machine catalog), Referral payouts. Auth via Supabase (admin role flag on user).
notes: Build order: 1) admin-approve-purchase edge fn, 2) admin-approve-drop edge fn, 3) /admin/Dashboard, /admin/Purchases, /admin/Drops, /admin/Settings, /admin/Users. Guarded by is_admin JWT claim.
close_reason: Admin Panel built at /admin/* guarded by is_admin JWT claim. Dashboard (stats), Purchases (approve/reject with reason modal, level lookup from user_machines), Drops (approve/reject with live balance warning), Settings (drop toggle, payment numbers editor, machine catalog editor with active toggle), Users (search by telegram_id/name). Admin edge functions: admin-approve-purchase (also pays referral bonus on first active machine for a referred user), admin-approve-drop (validates against live balance).

title: Per-second income calculation + 24/7 accrual
description: Each machine has daily_rate MMK. Server computes (now - start_time) * daily_rate / 86400. Frontend ticks every second updating displayed balance from server-anchored start_time. Implement as a Supabase Edge Function (cron-style) or computed on read. Verify the math: L1=2000/86400, L2=4000/86400, L3=7000/86400, L5=11000/86400, Super=24000/86400.
notes: Computed-on-read approach: v_user_balance view sums rate_per_sec × EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - start_time)) over active user_machines. BalanceTicker fetches v_user_balance_snapshot every 30s, interpolates 1Hz. No cron needed. NUMERIC(18,8) storage avoids float drift.
close_reason: Per-second math verified (1 day = 86400s). L1=2000/86400=0.023148, L2=0.046296, L3=0.081019, L5=0.127315, Super=0.277778 MMK/s. Implementation: computed-on-read via v_level_rate + v_user_balance views (NUMERIC(18,8) no float drift). Client uses v_user_balance_snapshot fetched every 30s and interpolates at 1Hz. No cron needed.

title: Build Telegram Mini App frontend (React + Vite + TS)
description: Pages: Home (machine catalog + balance + per-second live counter), My Machines (list with live accrual), Buy (machine selection + payment submission), Drop (withdraw request form, gated by admin toggle), Refer (referral link + count). Integrate Telegram Mini App SDK to get telegram_id. Deploy to Vercel.
notes: Build order: 1) bootstrap web/ Vite+React+TS, 2) client auth flow + tg-auth integration, 3) BalanceTicker + Home, 4) Buy + MyMachines, 5) Drop page gated by settings.drop_enabled, 6) Refer page + referral deep link parsing
close_reason: Frontend built: Vite+React+TS, router, supabase-js, @twa-dev/sdk, HashRouter routing. Pages: Home (live balance ticker), Buy (purchase form), MyMachines (per-machine accrual), Drop (gated by settings.drop_enabled), Refer (tg deep link + stats). Admin pages under /admin/* guarded by is_admin JWT claim: Dashboard, Purchases (with level lookup), Drops (with live balance warning), Settings (drop toggle + payment numbers + machine catalog), Users. BalanceTicker uses server-anchored snapshot + 1Hz local interpolation; re-syncs every 30s.

title: Set up Supabase project + database schema
description: Create Supabase project, design Postgres tables: users (telegram_id), machines catalog, user_machines (owned machines with purchase status + start_time for per-second accrual), transactions (purchase + drop requests with status, reason), referrals (referrer_id, referred_id), settings (drop_enabled, payment numbers). RLS policies for users vs admins.
notes: Build order: 1) Create remote Supabase project, 2) migrations 0001-0004 (schema, RLS, views, seed), 3) migration 0005 + Custom Access Token Hook, 4) tg-auth edge function
close_reason: All 5 migrations written (0001 schema, 0002 RLS with is_admin() JWT helper, 0003 views v_level_rate/v_user_balance/v_user_balance_snapshot, 0004 seed machines_catalog + default settings, 0005 custom_access_token_hook). Edge functions: tg-auth (HMAC-SHA256 initData validation, upsert user, referral parsing, admin session mint), admin-approve-purchase (approve/reject + referral bonus), admin-approve-drop (server-authoritative balance check). Supabase project creation blocked by OAuth scope in this environment; documented manual setup steps in README.md (project URL, link, db push, deploy functions, set BOT_TOKEN + ADMIN_TG_IDS, activate Custom Access Token Hook).
